messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert - automated page fired for metric pipeline: Prometheus scrape success rate dropped below 60% across multiple clusters. Pager: PD#98765.

pagerduty: Page triggered for escalation policy 'SRE - Metrics & Ingest'. Primary on-call: maya.

maya: ack - looking. seeing a ton of scrape failures + some 5xx responses from scrape-target-proxy.

aj: I see the same from the prometheus metrics: target_up{job="node_exporter"} is dropping, a lot of targets in UNKNOWN state. Also log-ingest-forwarder lag is rising (consumer lag ~120k).

liam: Confirming, Grafana panels show scrape_latency exploding for a subset of targets (~10-20% of hosts), CPU on the scrape-proxy pod is at 95%. Could be a traffic storm or a bad target causing timeouts.

sara: Any customer-facing impacts yet? Any 5xxs visible from hosted API?

maya: No direct 5xxs to public API so far. Some internal dashboards that rely on recent metrics are stale; support ticket #2321 just came in about alert fatigue (missing KPIs). Marking potential partial customer impact (dashboards & alerting delayed).

aj: Quick triage steps I'm doing: 
1) kubectl logs -n monitoring deployment/scrape-proxy -c proxy --tail=200
2) curl -s http://prometheus-main:9090/api/v1/targets?state=down | jq .

maya: Reassigning: aj and liam on metrics scrape, sara on customer comms/support triage, I'll own coordination and escalation.

liam: I ran the `targets` query - looks like a misbehaving target group: `k8s-prod/critical-app` has heavy scrape timeouts (timeouts ~60s). All failures started ~5m ago. Could be a faulty exporter or a config change.

maya: Rolling restart of the scrape-proxy to clear any stuck connections, will do a canary first (1/3 pods) -> `/runbooks/ingest/rolling-restart-scrape-proxy` (internal).

aj: Before restart, can we mute noisy alerts to avoid autopages while we mitigate? I'll mute rule `Prometheus: scrape_success_rate < 70%` for 15m in pager duty and alertmanager silence.

incident-bot: @maya created Incident RED-2026 and linked PD#98765.

maya: Canary restart done on scrape-proxy-0. Logs show a flood of `dial tcp <target_ip>:9100: i/o timeout` for critical-app hosts. Restart helped one pod but another proxy still pegged.

liam: I'm going to temporarily exclude the `k8s-prod/critical-app` target group from scrape configs via a quick relabel patch (remove from scrape job) to see if overall success rate recovers. If we remove the bad group, scrape throughput should come back and log-ingest lag may stabilize. Will prep patch and apply with dry-run first.

aj: Heads up: log-ingest-forwarder backlog correlates with the same time window. If scrapers backpressure, we may see batching blow up and Kafka consumer lag grow. I'm scaling consumer group `ingest-forwarder` by +2 replicas now.

sara: Sending internal note to support and CS: "Metrics may be delayed/stale for some customers, no API errors observed. Team investigating." Posting to #customer-status with a short blurb. :email:
